subject.title: [Feature]: Make Skill Workshop extensible for custom skill creation workflows

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class skill-creation authority/routing seam, rely on existing plugin tools plus `before_tool_call` policy, or document this as a ClawHub/plugin convention without new core API?
rationale: The request changes model-facing tool routing, plugin SDK semantics, and Skill Workshop governance; source inspection shows current hooks run after tool selection and current docs intentionally keep Skill Workshop as the governed write boundary.

options.title: Design a narrow authority seam
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved routing model that lets custom workflows prepare proposal content before Skill Workshop persists or applies it.

options.title: Document existing composition only
options.body: Keep current plugin tools and `before_tool_call` policy as the supported path, and document that they cannot guarantee pre-selection routing.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub conventions
options.body: Treat custom skill creation workflows as external plugin or skill-bundle patterns unless a stronger missing-core-API case appears.

recommendation.title: Design a narrow authority seam
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved routing model that lets custom workflows prepare proposal content before Skill Workshop persists or applies it.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily product/API direction across agent routing and plugin governance, and current-main blame plus repository policy make this the best available maintainer routing candidate.
